notes.title: Public Beta Update
notes.content:
[h1]Total Miner Public Beta Update[/h1]
Total Miner 2.20.7.1906, with animation additions, general gameplay fixes and tweaks is available for download.

[b]Backup Your Save Directory Before Switching[b]

[b]Updated to .NET 8[b]

[b]Instructions[b]
[list]
[*]Right Click on "Total Miner"
[*]Select "Betas" Tab
[*]Select Drop Down & Choose Open Beta
[/list]

[h2]What's Changed?[/h2]
[u][b]This update includes but is not limited to the following changes/additions/fixes:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*]Fixed: Plugins could not add custom NPCs.
[*]Fixed: Incorrect sliding block (eg. teflon) collision.
[*]Fixed: Mods not installing in certain cases.
[*]Fixed: Texture Pack dropdown going offscreen in certain cases.
[*]Fixed: Fixed One Way Glass texture visible on all sides.
[*]Fixed: String seeds changing after game reload.
[*]Fixed: Inventory screens breaking on season change.
[*]Fixed: Spectating now shows NPCs around other players.
[*]Fixed: Texture fixes (Jectz).
[*]Fixed: Legendary now works in multiplayer.
[*]Fixed: Multiplayer NPC targeting.
[*]Fixed: Trees cut off at chunk borders.
[*]Fixed: Some chunk meshes not loading.
[*]Fixed: System component pack menu sometimes mistakes player component pack as system packs.
[*]Fixed: Player input menu not allowing save after editing key.
[*]Fixed: Attack node serialization.

[*]Tweaked: Behaviour command can now only set behaviours for players in creative.
[*]Tweaked: World browser menu no longer shows worlds on different version.
[*]Updated: NPC Models & Animations
[*]Added Workshop Support
[*]- Some mods might not work due to targeting a different version of the game.

[*]Added Lua functions:
[*]- is_cursor_valid()
[*]- get_cursor_point()
[*]- get_cursor_face()
[*]- get_cursor_distance()
[*]- get_placement_point()
[*]- add_flying_block()
[*]- set_falling_block()
[*]Added: New Texture Packs (The Map Cartographer)
[*]Added: Survival Enemy Combat Rebalance
[*]Added: Fire Burning and Ice Freeze effects for Players/NPCs.
[*]Added: Fire and Ice Resistance/Vulnerability properties for Players/NPCs.
[*]Added: Power and Accuracy properties for Bows.
[*]Added: Multi-shot capability for Bows.
[*]Added: Piercing capability for Arrows.
[*]Added: Bow Range.
[*]Added: Better XML mod error reporting.
[*]Added: World player bans.
[*]Added: Player-based economy shops.
[/list]
And many more fixes not listed here

[h2]Workshop Support[/h2]
This public beta has support for the Steam Workshop, you can upload mods by clicking "Upload" in the mod info screen, and upload worlds by dragging them onto the upload button in the world browser menu.
If you encounter any issues with the workshop, be sure to let us know.
Feel free to join our Discord to talk to us and report any issues.

Thank you all to who support the game and the team :)

 - TM Dev Team

notes.title: Public Beta 2.9.6 Update
notes.content:
[h1]Greetings..again![/h1]

Our latest update for the Multiplayer Public Beta is now live.  To participate in the Open Public Beta please refer to the #play_now section of our [url=https://discord.gg/tgguCEfm]Discord Server.[/url]

This update is largely aimed at fixing and improving multiplayer hosting & joining stability & consistency, along with blueprint & wisdom scroll generation fixes and general quality of life improvements.

Here are [i]some[/i] of the notable changes/additions/fixes:
[list]
[*] Improved Multiplayer lobby hosting & joining stability.
[*] Multiplayer Ban System (to be improved upon)
[*] Pasting Components in multiplayer fixed.
[*] Blueprint Fixes.
[*] Shop Economization Fixes.
[*] Added 3D outlines for Marker/Exclude blocks.
[*] New GUI for script created interfaces.
[*] MagicaVoxel color palettes (in-depth guide coming soon).
[*] Many GUI menus ported to the new GUI framework.
[*] Improved sign text readability.
[*] Improved text spacing in books (makes them more readable).
[*] Added new item: Obsidian Shard.
[*] + Many more bug fixes & QoL changes.
[/list]

There are some bugs and missing features that we are aware of and are currently being worked on.  For more information on bug reports & upcoming fixes, please refer to our [url=https://discord.gg/tgguCEfm]Discord server[/url].


Thanks for stopping by, and cheers from the TM Development Team:  Craig, XBLToothPik, Native Function, Dave, Syn and everyone from our testing team and Discord admins.

[h3]Join our Discord: [url=https://discord.gg/tgguCEfm]Official Total Miner Discord Server[/url] to engage with the community & developers directly and to give your thoughts, feedback & suggestions![/h3]

notes.title: Multiplayer Public Beta Release 2.9.4
notes.content:
[h1]Greetings[/h1]

Our latest update for the Multiplayer Public Beta is now live.

This version is fully multiplayer capable and very close to what we will be releasing as the full public retail Total Miner 3.0 release.

So jump in, take a look, and join in the worlds of fun. If there aren't any to join, start one, and hopefully others will join ;)

There are hundreds of changes and fixes in new this version. Mostly around multiplayer and networking, and porting the remaining old screens to the new interface. There are also a lot of QOL improvements.

And here are a few notable additions:
[list]
[*]Player Stamina.
[*]New Mod Management tab.
[*]New World Preview tab.
[*]Mouse Look At fixes.
[*]New Dig Deep Nexus Tower.
[*]New Spider.
[/list]
We've also added in some frame based animation for the naturally spawning NPCs, just for some fun. This is not our final animation, but it is good for the interim.

We are still having problems with Dig Deep blueprints, so we'd advise not to play Dig Deep on this version. It will be fixed before the full 3.0 release.

Cheers from the TM Dev team: Craig, XBL, Native, Dave & Syn.
And everyone from our testing team and discord admins.

[list]
[*]PRESS ANY KEY prompt removed from startup screen.

[*]Added support for modded multiplayer servers (GetPluginNet).
[*]Added support for Arcade block game custom resolution.
[*]Added support for large numbers of new modded items. Shop screen has page #;
[*]Added CanBreatheUnderWater and ShowHitBoxes to NPC xml.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 2.62 released
notes.content:
[list]
    [*]Added mouse support to the old Block/Ground Selection window.
    [*]Moved MultiTexture2 block to Building tab.
    [*]Added Water and Lava to Creative Fill commands.
    [*]Added SaveRoot token to game.ini
[/list]

For those having problems with windows file access in the default Documents\My Games\TotalMiner path or if you just want to change it to something else, add an entry into the game.ini file like so:

SaveRoot=D:\GameSaves\TotalMiner

or whatever path you want that will not give the access errors.

To access the game.ini file, right click Total Miner in your library, select Properties, Local Files, Browse Local Files.
